elements.text: 4 of 5 material-plants checked are healthy and require no action. · Assumptions: analysis date: 2026-09-04 (index.md); near-term horizon: today + order processing time + avgLeadTimeDays of the vendor on the material-plant's open supply; if none, the shortest lead time among eligible approved vendors; if none is eligible, the longest lead time among approved vendors (rules/alerting.md); order processing time: 2 days from deciding to buy until the PO is with the vendor (rules/alerting.md); transfer lead time: 2 days (rules/transfer-limit.md); same-day ordering: demand is subtracted before supply is added on the same date (concepts/projected-stock.md); backlog: the balance may go negative; a missed requirement is still owed, and later supply fills it first (concepts/projected-stock.md); type decides commitment: requirementType decides committed (ProductionOrder, SalesOrder); priority only ranks within committed demand (concepts/committed-demand.md); north of ninety percent: strictly greater than 0.90 (rules/vendor-eligibility.md); alternate vendor price: unknown; premium to be quoted (rules/spending-policy.md); overdue supply: an open line whose confirmed date is before the analysis date is not counted until it is received (concepts/open-supply.md); past-due demand: a requirement dated before the analysis date that isn't Covered is still owed and counts as due on the analysis date (concepts/projected-stock.md)
